outcome: The Experiment revision rules now have real behaviour tests
owner_impact: Nothing changes in how revisions, the Working copy, Save Revision or Discard behave or what they say. The rules behind them (which revision you see when you reopen an Experiment, what the history list shows under All, Mine and AI, which revision a new Working copy is based on, what Discard does) now live in one small module with 9 tests that check what happens, instead of tests that only searched the code for exact lines. This makes the later split of the Lab's largest file safe.

next.text: Next is #547 — the same treatment for the Experiment Library's browsing rules (Showcase, Mine, Shared, Supervised, collections and search): behaviour tests instead of code-text checks, with nothing changing on screen. #547 has not started.

technical_evidence: New web/src/registry/revisions.js (pure: no DOM, no Supabase); registry-ui-v3.js delegates re-entry, baselines, Working-copy base revision, ownership labels, history entries, confirmation texts and post-discard state to it with identical texts.
New web/tests/registry-revisions.test.mjs: 9 behaviour tests for #397/#398/#399/#409; planted rule changes (re-entry to the Working copy, inverted AI filter) are caught.
Retired only the #398/#409 source-text assertions whose behaviour the new tests cover, replaced by checks that the registry calls the rule; 590 tests pass.
Style comparison of the built Lab identical to the current production build at all four viewports.
